duration.details: Until you cast this again or take a Safe Rest

description.baseEffect:
Cantrip · 1 Action · Shepherd Only.

Summon an Ethereal spirit companion (max 1) that moves when you do and is immune to harm. It can travel up to 4 spaces away from you. It lasts until you cast this spell again (the new spirit replaces it) or take a Safe Rest. You can use 1 Action to command it to do one of the following:

  • Harm | Reach: 4, Damage: 1d8+STR. Ignores armor. Damage type can be any from the schools you know.
  • Mend | (WIL/Safe Rest) Reach: 4. Restore WIL d20 HP to a Dying creature.

Outside Combat. Your companion is a spirit, so it can pass through most obstacles. It can be up to 12 spaces away before teleporting back to you. Many places are aware of such spells and ward off such spirits.

Rushed Attacks and My Companion? You and your companion use the same action pool, but count as different creatures. So you can each attack once without the Rushed Attack penalty every round.
